decision.observation: 6 mph, gear 1, two light-blue dots lit. The car is rolling on wet grass just right of the tarmac; the posted lane curves up and to the left past blue puddles toward the dark pines and a distant white structure at the top.
decision.hypothesis: The plain-W hold worked again. The lane is a few car widths to the left, so a short throttle-left steer should mount the tarmac before the water drags the car to a halt.
decision.memory: From the wet grass verge, plain W breaks the stall; steering left only works once rolling. Keep steers to 0.35-0.45s.
